# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and m152** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and updates the bundled renderer to Skia m152. The release adds asynchronous pixel reads and a Vulkan Silk.NET package, while improving native lifetime safety, data handling, and HarfBuzz shaping performance.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated through m152 servicing** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates subsequent upstream m151 and m152 fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Exposes the Graphite backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn integrations. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel reads added** — SKImage and SKSurface can now request pixel data asynchronously through backend-neutral APIs. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Vulkan Silk.NET integration packaged** — Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for applications using Silk.NET Vulkan bindings. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native pixel-source lifetimes corrected** — Keeps backing pixel sources alive for SKPixmap subset and With operations, preventing use-after-free failures. ([#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Raster-image failure cleanup improved** — Releases allocated pixel buffers when raster image creation fails. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Uniform and stream resources released correctly** — Disposes replaced runtime-effect uniform buffers and non-memory-backed streams converted to HarfBuzz blobs. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))

## Platform

- **Nano Server font support improved** — Uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Apple symbol packages generated** — Packages native symbols for Apple targets to improve native diagnostics. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Data and tag operations allocate less** — Avoids an extra buffer copy when saving SKData and removes unnecessary allocations from tag and encoded-text conversion paths. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves HarfBuzz shaping performance by avoiding an unnecessary defensive feature-array copy and fixes stream cleanup during blob conversion.
